My working philosophy
What I focus on

Strategy first. Technology where it helps.

I’m Sherine Moktan, an AI Marketing Expert focused on helping small and medium businesses grow through practical marketing strategy and thoughtfully chosen AI tools.

Business owners are often told they need to be everywhere, use every new tool, and produce more content. That can create activity without direction. My approach begins with your business: what you want to achieve, who you need to reach, what is getting in the way, and what your team can realistically manage.

From there, I help shape a focused plan. AI may support research, content workflows, customer follow-up, or campaign decisions—but it is always used in service of a clear marketing goal. Human judgment, brand understanding, and useful communication remain essential.

The result is a more manageable approach to marketing: clearer priorities, practical next steps, and tools selected for their usefulness rather than their novelty.

Why combine AI and strategy?

Tools can accelerate the work. Strategy makes the work matter.

AI can make parts of marketing faster, but speed alone does not create relevance. A strong strategy gives every tool a job to do.

  • ✓Explore customer questions and content ideas more efficiently.
  • ✓Create repeatable workflows for routine marketing tasks.
  • ✓Adapt useful content across appropriate channels.
  • ✓Review information and campaign signals with greater structure.
  • ✓Preserve your brand voice through careful human review.
